title: SSL/TLS Certificates Price Schedule
content:
SSL/TLS Certificates are sold as subscriptions of one, two or three years, and this rate card sets out the price of each Harborline certificate product for each length of subscription, the longest subscription that can be bought or renewed at once, the discount ladder for one order containing several new subscriptions, and the rounding applied to every computed certificate amount.

## Subscription prices (USD)

The 1-year figure is the price of a 1-year subscription. The 2-year and 3-year figures are prices **per year** of a 2-year or a 3-year subscription.

| Certificate product | 1-year subscription | Per year, 2-year subscription | Per year, 3-year subscription | Longest subscription bought or renewed at once |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline DV Single Domain | 19.99 | 17.99 | 15.99 | 3 years |
| Harborline DV Multi-Domain | 49.99 | 44.99 | 39.99 | 3 years |
| Harborline DV Wildcard | 89.99 | 80.99 | 71.99 | 3 years |
| Harborline OV Single Domain | 69.99 | 62.99 | 55.99 | 3 years |
| Harborline OV Wildcard | 219.99 | 197.99 | 175.99 | 3 years |
| Harborline EV Single Domain | 169.99 | 152.99 | 135.99 | 3 years |
| Harborline EV Multi-Domain | 279.99 | 251.99 | 223.99 | 3 years |

## Volume discount ladder (every product)

The ladder is the discount on certificate prices for one order containing several new subscriptions. Each step names the minimum number of certificates in the order and the discount percentage of that step.

| Minimum certificates in the order | Discount on certificate prices |
|---|---|
| 5 | 5 percent |
| 10 | 10 percent |

The ladder is the same for all seven certificate products.

## Rounding

Every computed certificate amount, for every product, is rounded half up to the cent.

## Reading the rate card

**Is the 2-year figure the price of both years together?** No. The 2-year and 3-year columns are prices per year: a 2-year subscription is priced at its per-year figure for each of its two years, and a 3-year subscription at its per-year figure for each of its three years.

**Can a subscription of four years be bought?** No product allows it: the longest subscription that can be bought or renewed at once is 3 years for every product.

**Where is the cheapest yearly rate of a product?** For each product the per-year figure falls as the subscription lengthens; for the Harborline OV Wildcard, for instance, it is 219.99 for one year, 197.99 per year over two years and 175.99 per year over three years.
